title: International Travelers Can Now Enroll in CLEAR+
summary: CLEAR is excited to announce that travelers with international passports from Canada, the U.K., Australia, and more will be able to enroll in CLEAR+.
body_markdown:
Whether you’re flying for business, reuniting with loved ones, **** or off on your next adventure, CLEAR+ lets you speed through security at any of our 150+ Lanes across 62 airports. We’re thrilled that this fast, frictionless experience is now available to global travelers.


‍


## **Who’s Eligible?**


Travelers with **valid, unexpired international passports that include a photo ID** from these countries can now enroll in CLEAR+:


- Andorra
- Australia
- Austria
- Belgium
- Brunei
- Canada
- Chile
- Croatia
- Czech Republic
- Denmark
- Estonia
- Finland
- France
- Germany
- Greece
- Hungary

- Netherlands

- San Marino
- Singapore
- Slovakia
- Slovenia
- South Korea
- Spain
- Sweden
- Switzerland
- Taiwan
- The United Kingdom


‍


## **How It Works**


Once you enroll in CLEAR+, simply head to the CLEAR+ Lane at airport security where we’ll verify You are YOU with our face-first technology. Then, our friendly Ambassador will bring you straight to security screening, making it one of the[fastest ways to get through airport security](https://www.clearme.com/blog/how-to-get-through-airport-security-faster) .


CLEAR+ is available in the U.S. at 150+ Lanes across 62 airports.


‍


## **What About Global Entry?**


While **Global Entry** is great for reentry into the U.S., CLEAR+ Members enjoy a faster, easier security experience when flying out of the U.S.—no interviews, no appointments, and now, open to global travelers.


‍


## **Ready to Enroll?**


International travelers from **40 countries** can start their enrollment[online](https://enroll.clearme.com/enroll/) and finish at the airport before their next trip.
